Text:
The Fannie Brown Booth Memorial Library's "Unearth A Story" summer reading program is wrapping up this month — and it's been a good one.

Dinosaur fossils, storytime, crafts, and a whole lot of books checked out. If your kids participated this summer, they earned it.

Good things happen when a community invests in its library. Center is lucky to have one worth showing up for.

📍 Fannie Brown Booth Memorial Library — 800 Shelbyville St., Center, TX
🌐 centerlibrary.org

Text:
Sunday, July 27 is National Korean War Armistice Day — the anniversary of the 1953 agreement that ended three years of combat and brought home the men and women who served.

VFW Post 8904 will hold a remembrance ceremony at the Veterans Memorial in Center. The event is open to the public. If you have family ties to the Korean War — a grandfather, an uncle, a neighbor who served — this is a meaningful way to honor them.

More than 36,000 Americans gave their lives in Korea. Shelby County sent its own.

📍 Veterans Memorial — Center, TX
🕐 Contact VFW Post 8904 for ceremony time
